entities.summary: Rachel Kerina Chikwamba is a Zimbabwean plant geneticist born in 1967. She is in the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) Group Executive: Strategic Alliances and Communication. She is an active member of the Academy of Science of South Africa. Rachel Chikwamba was a scientists & inventors from Zimbabwe (b. 1967). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
